protocol.note: One training seed per condition, different from the original three-seed proportion study. A development comparison, not an ablation isolating any single change.

quadruped.label: Coordinated walking · quadruped
quadruped.selection: Highest mean return on separate validation episodes
quadruped.packaging: Re-exported the identical frozen weights and normalizer; fingerprint unchanged.

varied.label: Coordinated walking · varied
varied.selection: Highest mean return on separate validation episodes

gait_rule: 20 s without falling; mean speed error <=0.35 m/s; >=6 completed steps per leg; 15–85% grounded time per leg; foot-center drift <=0.35 m/s; pitch RMS <=0.25 rad.
limits: One new training seed per condition. Multiple training changes together. Reuses the previous proportion benchmark with fresh episode seeds. Foot-center drift includes spherical-foot rolling. Original controllers are historical baselines, not a matched ablation.
